We are seeking an experienced SRE to engineer the reliability of our highly distributed platform. • Partner with Product Engineering teams during the design phase to ensure new services are built with reliability, scalability, and observability patterns (circuit breakers, rate limiting, backpressure, fallback strategies) from day one.

.

• Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud providers (AWS/Azure). You are proficient in running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and troubleshooting cluster/infrastructure issues.

• Experience designing observability strategies using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, New Relic, Datadog, or SigNoz to improve system visibility.

• Familiarity with operating and tuning production data stores (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ) in a high-throughput environment.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for the architecture, operation and development of Cash Access UK ’s data platform, built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. The role works closely with the Insights & Analysis team, business data owners, the Data Governance Consultant, Technology Operations, suppliers and the Head of Data and Technology to keep the platform reliable, bring new data into it safely and ensure the data it holds can be trusted for reporting and decision making.
The platform brings together data from the banking hubs, the Post Office and community banking channels, incident and survey systems, reference data, member banks and public data sources. It was built with a delivery partner and is now moving into business-as-usual operation, and the Senior Data Engineer takes ownership of it as that transition completes, including the runbook, documentation, backlog, alerting and recovery arrangements.
This is a hands-on engineering role where design, build and operation sit with the post holder rather than with a supplier. The Senior Data Engineer is accountable for the platform’s data pipelines, data models, databases, APIs and Microsoft Fabric integrations, for the engineering standards that govern how they are built and released, and for reducing the organisation’s reliance on supplier-led development.
The role supports data quality and governance by implementing the data quality rules, critical data elements, definitions, lineage, classification, access controls and retention set through the data governance framework, so that governance is built into how data is ingested, transformed and shared. The Data Governance Consultant establishes the framework and Microsoft Purview; this role implements them in the platform.
The role will also help set the direction of the platform over the longer term, including new data sources and integrations, the data foundations for Finance reporting and dashboards, and the governed datasets that allow approved AI tools to be used, working with the wider Technology team, the Insights & Analysis team, Risk and relevant suppliers to prioritise the backlog.
The role also acts as a business partner within the IT function, working with Finance, Risk, Compliance, Projects, Change and wider business teams to make data practical, trusted and usable. The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

 

Position Summary

EDDA's cables are its nerves, and we're hiring the person who owns them: every harness in the product - power, signal, data and fiber - from wire list through connector selection, routing across moving axes, bench prototyping, qualification and production sourcing. You have shipped rugged, high-flex-life harnesses and are equally at home with copper, fiber and hybrid builds.

EDDA is the low-cost counter-UAS solution, so the job is one judgment made hundreds of times: rugged where it matters, cost-efficient where it doesn't. MIL-spec circular connectors and continuous-flex cable where a harness crosses the elevation axis and takes recoil; a less-rugged sealed connector and standard jacket where it sits bolted inside the base. You defend each call with test data and a cost roll-up.

 

What You'll Own

- Power: battery, bus and motor-drive feeds - conductor sizing, voltage drop, thermal budgets, fusing, grounding.

- Test and qualify: flex, pull and vibration rigs; continuity, hipot and insertion-loss tests; shock, vibration, temperature, water and dust qualification; root-cause failures that come back from the range.

- Engineer the cost: hold the harness BOM to target - standardize connector families, cut unique part numbers, go rugged only where the requirement demands it.
